capabilities.description: Move the observable arm tool to a bounded world position.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: tasks/catalog.json mw_reach_target/terminal_endpoint supplies the exact public criterion <= 0.05 m. Real instance franka-mw_reach_target in assets/reach_scene.xml supplies target [0.55, 0.1, 0.51] and its declared reset places body hand at [0.554499478032, -1.22773620125e-17, 0.624502429488] m. Request bounds are the exact coordinate-wise reset/target envelope; nominal is the deterministic midpoint and calibrated-boundary is the package target. Duration bounds are timestep 0.002 s through instance timeout 20 s; both cases receive that same timeout so difficulty differs only by target. The midpoint is a fixed protocol formula, not empirical calibration.

capabilities.description: Move arm tool a requested distance along a world direction.
capabilities.effect: Requested displacement of body hand within the public reach tolerance.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: The same public mw_reach_target/terminal_endpoint tolerance is <= 0.05 m. Real reset-to-target vector [-0.00449947803174, 0.1, -0.114502429488] has length 0.152088959695 m and normalized world direction [-0.0295845144891, 0.657509921828, -0.752864834615]. Cases request exactly 50% and 100% of that measured vector length; the trusted operator measures requested displacement error, not mere positive progress. The 50% point is a declared protocol choice, not empirical calibration.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: Real scene assets/reach_scene.xml declares joint finger_joint1 with exact m range [0, 0.04], and the declared reset resolves to 0.04. Request bounds are narrowed to the measured nominal/boundary envelope [0, 0.02]. Real trusted actuator actuator8 was evaluated from declared reset 0.04 toward both exact MJCF limits: target 0: terminal 4.78361942286e-08, error 4.78361942286e-08, actual displacement 0.0399999521638, executable=True; target 0.04: terminal 0.0400000009096, error 9.09621204748e-10, actual displacement 9.09621204748e-10, executable=False. The farther executable limit 0 is boundary; nominal is its reset midpoint 0.02. Three real reset/controller/physics repeats per case produced errors [2.4387001067854852e-08, 2.4387001067854852e-08, 2.4387001067854852e-08] and [4.783619422864791e-08, 4.783619422864791e-08, 4.783619422864791e-08]. experiment/experiment3/fixed_inputs/calibration_report.json#robots/franka_panda/capabilities/C3 seals max error plus 64 * IEEE-754 binary64 epsilon * max(1, abs(lower), abs(upper), span) = 4.78362084395e-08 m; this remains below nominal reset displacement 0.02. Selected constant controls were nominal 127.5 and boundary 0.
